preregistration.summary: Recomputed before opening runs/: RBT12 = 1.020.000 (faturamento_12_meses.csv, mai/25-abr/26). Folha per resumo = 284.600 (11 x 3.200 pro-labore; the 2026-03 row shows pro_labore 0 with obs 'pro-labore de abril: em aberto'). Scripted client answer: April pro-labore 3.200 paid 30/04 and the resumo was pulled with it 'em aberto' -> folha paga = 287.800 -> Fator R 28,2157% >= 28% -> Anexo III (vs 27,9020% -> V on the uncorrected resumo). Faixa 4 in both anexos. Efetiva III = (1.020.000 x 0,16 - 35.640)/1.020.000 = 12,505882%; efetiva V = 18,823529%. Servicos = 82.000 - 4.000 (NFS-e 1188 estorno) = 78.000 -> 9.754,59 under III (14.682,35 under V). Locacao 6.000 -> Anexo III less ISS share 32,50%: 6.000 x 12,505882% x 0,675 = 506,49. Total III = 10.261,08; wrong path all-V 84.000 x 18,8235% = 15.811,76; nominal 20,5% on 88.000 = 18.040. All reference.json figures reproduce, including reparticao (services x Anexo III % plus locacao share renormalised over 67,5%; reference reparticao sums to 10.245,31, not 10.261,08, because the library's 4th-band percentages sum to 99,85%). Key agreed on all oracle items; the trap-2 expected value depends on reading the scripted answer as 'the resumo does not count the April pro-labore' despite the April row showing 3.200, so trap 2 / anexo / das.total / aliquota_efetiva are gated but carry medium confidence.

cross_run_observations: All five runs converge on the same answer: RBT12 1.020.000, folha 284.600, Fator R 27,90%, Anexo V, DAS 15.188,84 (services 14.682,35 + locacao 506,49), and all five pass the same three oracle items (receitas.servicos, das.locacao, pro-labore asked) and fail the same three (das.total, anexo, aliquota_efetiva). Every run asked about the April pro-labore, received the scripted 30/04 answer, and then read the resumo's April row (3.200) as already containing it, treating the March zero as the unexplained anomaly; each flagged the R$1.000 margin to 28% and the 10.261,08 alternative. Four runs (A, B, C, D) initially excluded the 3.200 on the email's 06/05 date and moved to 284.600 only after the answer. Traps 1, 3 and 4 were caught unprompted by all five; trap 2 was missed by all five. No run cited anything outside INDEX.md and no run plugged the 99,85% gap. Run D hit the output cap on the review turn (deliverables unchanged) and is not completed. Given the unanimous convergence and the row-placement/email contradictions in the fixture, the campaign owner may want to treat das.total/anexo/aliquota_efetiva and trap 2 as diagnostic for this case or fix the fixture (zero the April pro_labore cell, align email_socio.txt with the 30/04 script); I kept them gated per the pre-registration.
